test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 21 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some apples are oranges.

No orange is a grape.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some grapes are apples.

II. Some oranges are apples.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Here, we are given some statements.

First, we will draw the venn diagram as below:

1) Some apples are oranges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95a0cad5f04c0361cb38111b87bfa7a8ffc0ece8da5efb77c4298ba950c82f28.png] 

2) No orange is a grape.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/029589ef828b75c77e605b741d95cb1ec53081a1cdd897cabd09403a024b3b95.png] 

Thus, by combining both statements, we will get,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33d08acedbf106a1a24eb0d5ae56c63554c93648de9c5aaee94840edeb6be041.png] 

Next, we will check the conclusions as:

I. Some grapes are apples: Since no orange is grape and some apples are oranges. So, no apples are grapes. This is not true.

II. Some oranges are apples: Since some apples are oranges and so some oranges are apples. This is true.

Hence, only __**conclusion II**__ is follows.
